Information
Passive: Toggle

"This is it. The Peak over Power" 

Passive

If you were to obtain a True Dragon Ultimate Skill after obtaining Azathoth, God of The Void, the user can use the command /trnightmare TrueDragonNucleation sacrifice Veldora/Velgrynd/Valzard/Velgaia to add it into the Azathoth Skill, however this cost 1,000,000 MP to do. 

[Passive, True] Spacetime Manipulation - The user obtains Spacetime Manipulation, and when mastered, they obtain Spacetime Domination.

[Passive, Toggle] Null - The user bypasses Resistances and degrades Nullifications. The user is immune to Critical Hits. The user has 50% Dodge Chance negation.

[Passive, True] Nihility Bar - The user gains a new resource bar, it is a purple bar beside their MP and AP bar. It scales from 0 to 100,000 Nihility.

Actives

[Active, Press] Imaginary Space - When used normally, this opens a 66 page spatial storage with a max stack size of 999. When shift used, this will warp the user into their Imaginary Space Dimension, if used next to players or entities, it will also pull them in.

While in the Imaginary Space, you can press this ability on someone normally to eject them out of the dimension, and shift use it to get out, or take people out of it with you.

Each person's Imaginary Space is different, can be built and lived it, without worry, as it is their own unique dimension.

[Active, Held] Soul Gluttony - This is a powerul rending predation ability which slowly pulls things into it. It instantly kills any entity with less than 60% of the user's EP or an Ultimate Skill. This does 450 Spiritual Damage and 150 Void Damage

[Active Held] Darkest Void - The user produces a blackhole, similarly to Beelzebuth's, but when shift used, it begins to power the blackhole up, and can be thrown when release from shift held.

The Blackhole does 50 Spiritual Damage and 50 Void Damage, and has it's damage increased by the Soul Points the user has, up to a maximum of 250. When damaged, this will apply Soul Rot, making them unable to heal their Spiritual Health.

[Active, Press] Multidimensional Barrier - The user creates a Barrier with x4 HP (6x when mastered) as well as the benefits of Fault Field while the user has the Barrier Points.

[Active, Held] Nihility Generation - When held the user begins to generate Nihility. This generates 500 Nihility per second. When mastered, if the user has a Raphael Manas, the manas can use Nihility Supply to make this passive.

[Active, In-Slot] Imaginary Blade - The user imbues their Nihility inside of their blade. It cost 1,500 Nihility per attack and deals 250 Void Damage per hit. Anything "killed" is instead pulled into the Imaginary Space. When mastered, this only requires 1,000 Nihility per attack.

This can copy the skills of the target from Resistances to Extras when it sends them to the Imaginary Space.

[Active, Press] True Dragon Release - The user can shift between modes to select [ Storm / Scorch / Frost / Earth ] if they possess the different True Dragon.

This can be used to place the True Dragon into your Body, allowing them free roam, however unlike Dragon Summoning, the True Dragon Release variants have the ability to save the skills they possess, meaning they can obtain their evolved Ultimate Skills and use them.

[Active, Held] True Dragon Nucleation - The user can begin producing a nucleation core in front of them. The user can shift between modes to select [ Storm / Scorch / Frost / Earth ] if they possess the different True Dragon.

You can only make one True Dragon Nucleation Core of each type.

Nuclation Cores

[Storm Nucleation Core]

This core deals 50 Water, Wind, Lightning and Lightning Damage while in-slot. 

[Scorch Nucleation Core]

This core deals 200 Flame Damage while in-slot.

[Frost Nucleation Core]

This core deals 200 Cold Damage while in-slot.

[Earth Nucleation Core]

This core deals 100 Earth and 100 Gravity Damage while in-slot.

None of these Damages are modified by Dominations or Manipulations.

[True Nucleation Core]

When all four cores are slotted into the same item, they gain the following:

Soul Nucleation:

The user produces an attack using the Nucleation Cores inside of the weapon alongside Azathoth's Nihility Collapse. This requires 50,000 Nihility but will produce powerful blackhole similarly to Darkest Void, but will also apply Black Burn, Chill, Overheat and Anti-Skill.

Overheat is a new status effect which reduces the target's Attack Damage by 10 per level.

Information
Points to Master: 5000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Tempt Control - The user gains Spacetime Manipulation on obtainment of Azazel. When Azazel and Spacetime Manipulation are mastered, Spacetime Manipulation evolves into Spacetime Domination.

[Passive, True] All of Creation - The user instantly learns all Aspectual Magic. The user instantly learns all Recipes.

[Passive, In-Slot] Solicitation - While this skill is in Slot, the user will be able to copy sub-skills similarly to Pride.

[Passive, Toggle] Thought Acceleration - Increases the amount of Learned Points and Mastery Points gained for Magics by 4. Thought Acceleration (Like Normal) .Chant Annulment (Like Normal)

[Passive, In Slot]

[Passive, True]

Active

[Active, Press] Multidimensional Barrier - The user creates a Barrier with x4 HP (6x when mastered) as well as the benefits of Fault Field while the user has the Barrier Points.

[Active, Press] Charm Domination - Ineffective on targets with an EP over 60% (40 if target has Spiritual Resist) of the user’s Max EP. Turns Targets between 25% and 50% Neutral (5 - 30 if target has Spiritual Resist), and turns targets below 25% (5 if target has Spiritual Resist) Max EP into temporary allies for 5 minutes (10 with Mastery). Costs 80 MP + Target’s EP [Looking at Target in 5 block radius, Shift to undo]

[Active, Press] Temptation World - The user warps all nearby non-allies into the Temptation World with the user. All targets are inflicted with Magic Jamming.

[Active, Press] Solicitation - The user opens their Solicitation Menu, which allows them to use the modes of copied skills from Tempter, only in the Temptation Dimension.

[Active, Press] Severed Realm - The user can throw an enemy into the Temptation World. This is similar to Infinity Prison, so if you miss, it goes on cooldown, after four minutes, the enemy is release from the Temptation World. (5 cd on failure, 25 on success)

[Active, press] End of World - The user collapses the Temptation Dimension in on itself, with a white flash. This deals 3,000 Spiritual Damage to all entities inside of it, including the user. This is reduced to 1,500 if your EP is within 50% of the user's EP. If your EP is less than 50% of the users, this will instantly kill you. (500 cd)

[Active, Press] End of World: Requiem (Requires 100 uses of End of World and Mastery over Azazel) - The user simulates the collapse of the temptation world inside of a target, It causes a massive explosion from the target and deals 5,000 SHP damage and 5,000 Darkness Damage. It instantly kills a Charmed Target or target under 50% of the user's EP. (760 cd)

[Active, Press] Punitive Domination - When used all of the user's nearby allies glow green, targets which fear them glow red and mind controlled targets glow blue. When the user activates this ability a second time, it will reveal the percentage of HP the targets are at.

When shift used, the user will kill all Mind Controled Targets and targets with Fear 4 or higher (so long as they do not have more than 60% of the user's EP) instantly. If they can resist this effect, it instead damages them for half of their SHP by half (25% if they have Spiritual Resistances). This doesn't bypass Nullification. (320 cd).

Information
Points to Master: 5000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Multi-Dimensional Barrier

[Passive, Toggled] Saviour - The user's Presence Sense is increased by 4 + 1/4th of X. The user's MP regeneration is increased by 1/8th of X. The user's Attack Damage is increased by 1/2 of X. The user reduces damage by a percent equal to 1/6th X. X is equal to the number of Saved targets. The user can only save one entity of each type, like Reaper, or, once per unique player.

[Passive, In-Slot] Danger Detection - The user gains 30% Dodge Chance and 50% Critical Chance.

Active

[Active, Held] Hostility Erasure - While held, the user becomes "peaceful". While peaceful, no mobs will attack the user. The user will take 99% less damage. This becomes a toggle press when mastered. Hostility Erasure ends when you deal damage to another entity. Using Haki doesn't bypass this.

[Active, Inslot/Press] Retribution - The user's attacks have a chance to apply the Salvation effect to a target for 30 seconds. When pressed, the user will deal 250 Spiritual Damage to all targets within a 128-block radius of them for every level of Salvation they possess. This is a 30% Chance / 60% Chance when mastered. Salvation's Effect Cap is 8, 12 when mastered.

[Active, Held] Purgatory - When held, the user will instantly teleport to the lowest HP target with the Salvation effect in a 128-block radius, or the target with the highest level of Salvation, if they are more than 12 blocks away. When held within 12 blocks of a target with Salvation, they will instead begin to slash at them, dealing their Attack Damage x 2 (Counting as a melee attack, like how some battlewills do). Each hit will reduce a level of Salvation, and they can keep hitting them one time for every level of Salvation. If this attack hits a target below 50% of the user's EP, they are instantly killed and marked as "Saved" following the Saviour rules.

[Active, In-Slot] Life Domination - Polar Star - When in slot, the user deals X% of their attack damage as bonus Spiritual Damage to a target. X equals the number of saved targets. If the user would die with Polar Star in slot, they can instead prevent their death; they instead restore X% of their HP and SHP. (X equals the number of saved targets, but never more than 50%.) This has a 120-second cooldown.
